_about: Every voice-over line in Aqua Energizer. make_voices.bat reads this file. Edit a line's text, then choose 'Redo one line'. Words in [brackets] are ElevenLabs audio tags (v3/v4 models): they set the delivery and are not spoken.

audition.narrator: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls. [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
audition.diver: [excited] Woohoo! The light's back! [giggles] Easy as bubbles!
audition.pip: [excited] I'm Pip! The storm blew out my glow, but look, I'm sparkling again!
audition.shelly: [warmly, slowly] Hop on, little one. I'll take you as far as my old flippers go.
audition.murk: [softly] It's warm... I'd forgotten what light feels like.
audition.lumen: [cheerful] Twenty gates! The whole Deep felt that. I'll light your way.
audition.friend: [cheerful] Found 'em in the sand after the storm! We're taking 'em back to the gates.
audition.grimtide: [menacing, low] Thirty little gates… and one little light. [whispers] I will drink it all.

lines.text: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls.
lines.when: Intro film: the reef at night

lines.text: [a little worried] One night, a huge storm hits the reef…
…and sweeps all the pearls away. [whispers] The reef goes dark.
lines.when: Intro film: the lights blow away

lines.text: [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
lines.when: Intro film: the helmet lamp clicks on

lines.text: Swim into the sand to dig a tunnel.
The tunnel reaches the gate. Now get behind the red pearl…
lines.when: Intro film: diver above the gate

lines.text: [excited] …and push it to the gate!
[amazed] The gate wakes up, and the light comes back!
Twenty-nine gates are still dark. [warmly] Can you wake them all?
This is you. Swim, dig and push your way to the gate.
This red pearl is full of light. The gate needs it.
Push the pearl in to wake the gate, then swim in yourself.
Air starts on your first move, so look around first. Finish before it runs out!
Swipe to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Use the arrow keys to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Take the sand away under a stone, and it falls.
[gently] Never stand right under a stone!
Falling stones and pearls roll off round things, and they roll left first.
[a little worried] It patrols the water, and charges the moment it sees you.
[playfully] Drop a stone on it to stop it for good.
It drifts up and down its shaft. Cross when it is far away.
It scuttles back and forth. Stay out of its path!
[brightly] Swim into it for forty-five more seconds of air.
[warmly] Deeper now. Welcome to the Coral Caves. [softly] Plan before you dig.
[hushed] This is The Deep. Only the bravest divers come this far.
[cheerfully] Today's dive is the same for every diver. Ready? Go!
[amazed] Every gate is awake. The whole reef is glowing again!
[warmly] Thank you, little diver. The Glow Reef shines because of you.
[excited] Woohoo! The light's back!
Gate's awake. Onward!
[giggles] Easy as bubbles!
[sighs] Oof… let's try that again.
[determined] Hold on, I've got this!
[happy] Got one!
One more!
[giggles] In you go!
[excited] It's open!
Yes! Let's go!
[gasps] Ooh, treasure!
[giggles] Bonk!
[excited] Double!
[relieved] Phew!
That was close!
[nervous] I need air!
Whoops!
[playfully] Wait, wait… one more time!
[softly] The first gate wakes, and its light rushes into an old pipe.
[softly] The pipe carries you out onto the sand, toward the next glass tank.
[curious] Psst! Down here! You woke a gate? Nobody’s done that since the storm!
[warmly] I just followed the light. Who are you?
[excited] I’m Pip! The storm blew out my glow, and every light in the reef.
[excited] But when your gate woke, I sparkled. Look, just a little!
[excited] That storm wasn’t normal. I saw two red eyes inside it… and then everything went black.
[excited] Then let’s bring the light back. Every last bit of it.
[warmly, slowly] Red eyes, you say? Then the old tale is true. Grimtide is back.
[warmly, slowly] A giant eel who drinks light. The Reef Keeper chased him into the abyss, long ago.
[warmly, slowly] He wants the Heart Pearl inside the Great Lantern. With it, the whole sea would be his.
[warmly, slowly] Thirty gates guard the way. Wake them all, and his storm can’t hold. Hop on!
[cheerful] A parade of crabs marches past, each one carrying a rescued pearl.
[cheerful] We dug ’em out of the sand! The storm dropped ’em like hailstones.
[cheerful] The rest were dragged off by a long, dark tail. Thicker than a shipwreck!
[excited] Grimtide… He’s collecting them.
[cheerful] The jellies remember the gates. They hum whenever one wakes.
[excited] Five gates! Listen, the jellies are humming!
[cheerful] They make a bouncy stair to lift you on your way.
[excited] Boing… boing… whoa! Thank you, jellies!
[gently] Inside an old shipwreck sits a chest with a seashell clasp.
[gently] In it: a map of all thirty gates, and a page from the Reef Keeper’s journal.
[softly, like a memory] “If Grimtide ever returns, wake the gates. Shared light is the one thing he cannot drink.”
lines.when: Chapter 6 · The Keeper’s Map (The Reef Keeper)

lines.text: [curious] With this map, we can never get lost!
[tense, low] In a dark hollow, a soft light glows. A gate? It looks just like one…
[scared] Wait! Gates don’t flicker like that…
[tense, low] The light snaps shut. It was a lure, and the water bursts into ink!
[menacing, low] Thank you for the map, little light. Now you’ll never find your way.
[scared] He took the map… and my glow… it’s going out again.
[curious] Without the map we’re lost. This is all my fault…
[warmly] It isn’t, Pip. We’ll find the way. Look!
[gently] The fish remember the gates. They swirl together into a silver arrow.
[curious] They’re showing us the way! We don’t need his map!
[gently] At the top of the great dune, something flutters in the sand.
[excited] A piece of the map! Grimtide tore it in his hurry!
[gently] Half a map is better than none. And it points down. Way down!
[excited] Hold on, Pip!
[gently] The torn map ends at a cliff. Far below, the Coral Caves glow violet.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (narrator)

lines.text: [determined] Grimtide went down there. What if he’s waiting for us?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (Pip)

lines.text: [determined] Then he’ll see us coming, with our lights on. Together?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (You)

lines.text: [determined] …Together!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (Pip)

lines.text: [tense, low] The Coral Caves are dark. Your lamp wakes the crystals, one by one.
[whispers, echoing] Turn back, little light… The dark is mine.
[scared] He can see us…
[determined] Let him look. Eleven gates, Pip. We’re not turning back.
[softly, sadly] Giant clams open, one after another, and sing the Keeper’s old song.
[softly, like a memory] “Share your light, and the light comes home…”
lines.when: Chapter 12 · The Silent Clam (The Clam Choir)

lines.text: [softly, sadly] But the last clam stays shut. Grimtide has stolen its pearl.
[sadly, quietly] Then we’ll take it back. All of them.
[tense, low] Without warning, the water turns black. Grimtide’s storm has found you.
[menacing, low] Thirteen gates? That’s thirteen too many!
[weakly] Get behind me, little ones!
[tense, low] Shelly takes the whole blow on her old shell… and sinks slowly to the sand.
[sadly, quietly] Shelly? Shelly, please wake up…
[weakly] My old shell has seen worse storms… but I can’t swim on with you.
[weakly] Promise me you’ll wake every gate. Every last one.
[softly] We promise, Shelly.
[softly, sadly] The glimmer jellies gather round her, glowing softly, to keep her warm.
[gently] With heavy hearts, you swim on. At the Great Canyon, a manta waits.
[cheerful] Shelly sent word through the currents. Climb on, little ones.
[cheerful] She said: “Tell them not to look back. Tell them I’m proud.”
[excited] Fifteen gates… This one’s for you, Shelly.
[tense, low] Deep in the caves, something huge blinks in the dark.
[tense, low] Two great eyes, and arms wrapped in chains of ink.
[whispering] Help me… He makes me gather the pearls…
[tense, low] A cruel tail drags the shape back into the black.
[gently] The old Coral Arch still remembers the light. Its lamps wake as you swim through.
[softly, like a memory] “Grimtide fears one thing: light that is given away.”
lines.when: Chapter 17 · The Arch’s Secret (The Coral Arch)

lines.text: [determined] That poor creature in chains… Grimtide is using him.
[determined] Then we’ll free him too.
[gently] Pearls float up from the sand like lanterns, a trail leading deeper.
[excited] The prisoner dropped them! He’s showing us the way, in secret!
[gently] Somewhere in the dark, someone is brave enough to help.
[excited] Hold on, whoever you are. We’re coming.
[cheerful] Pip’s cousins race in from the Shallows, glowing with news.
[excited] Pip! Shelly woke up! She’s resting, and she’s going to be okay!
[excited] She’s okay! She’s okay!
[excited] Nineteen gates. Come on, even faster now!
[tense, low] From the last cliff of the caves, you see it at last: the Great Lantern.
[tense, low] Around it, coiled like a storm cloud, lies Grimtide.
[menacing, low] Come closer, little light. The Heart is almost mine.
[scared] Twenty lights on the tower… and he’s trying to drink them!
[gently] Into the Deep, where the sun has never reached.
[cheerful] Over here! Quick, before his eyes find you.
[cheerful] I’m Lumen. Grimtide hunts every light in the Deep. I’ve been hiding for weeks.
[cheerful] But if you’re going after him… my little light is yours.
[softly] High above, a whale sings for the first time since the storm.
[cheerful] That’s Old Bellow. His song means the Lantern is fighting back.
[curious] Twenty-one gates. Grimtide is getting weaker!
[softly] Far away, an angry roar shakes the Deep. Grimtide heard it too.
[gently] An old sea city sleeps in the dark. Its columns glow as you pass.
[gently] On the last wall, a mural: the Reef Keeper and a purple octopus, driving Grimtide into the abyss.
[cheerful] That octopus is Murk, the Keeper’s best friend.
[curious] The prisoner! Grimtide took him… to get his revenge.
[tense, low] Your gate wakes, and for one moment everything shines.
[menacing, low] ENOUGH!
[tense, low] A great tail smashes through the water. The light goes out, and Pip is torn away into the dark.
[far away] Heeelp!
[determined] PIP!
[warmly, slowly] Did someone call for an old turtle?
[excited] Shelly! You’re all right! But Grimtide took Pip…
[warmly, slowly] Then we go and get him back. Hold on tight, little one.
[warmly, slowly] Two hundred years I’ve waited to give that eel a piece of my mind.
[gently] In a den of stolen pearls sits Murk, in chains of ink. Beside him hangs a cage… with Pip inside.
[softly] You came… I’m sorry. He made me guard your friend.
[gently] You hold up a glowing pearl. Light, given away, and the ink chains melt.
[softly] Free… I’m free! Now let’s get your friend out.
[curious] I knew you’d come! I knew it!
[firmly] Climb on. I know the way to his lair.
[gently] Murk carries you all over the deepest trench in the sea.
[firmly] He took my home, my freedom, and the Keeper’s light. Now he’ll answer for it.
[determined] Twenty-seven gates. We’re coming, Grimtide!
[cheerful] Wave your arms, little Keeper! Show the Deep it isn’t alone!
[triumphant] Every wave sets the plankton glowing. Then the jellies, the crabs, the fish…
[triumphant] Every creature that hid from Grimtide lights up, all at once.
[excited] Twenty-eight gates! The whole sea is with us!
[tense, low] At the foot of the Great Lantern, Grimtide waits, the Heart Pearl clutched in his coils.
[menacing, low] One gate left, little light. Wake it, and I’ll drink every drop.
[firmly] Not this time.
[determined] Twenty-nine gates are shining, Grimtide. One more, and it’s over.
[triumphant] The last gate wakes. Thirty beams of light rush down to the Lantern.
[panicked] No… NO! It burns!
[triumphant] All the light he stole pours out of him, and the great eel shrinks… to a tiny, wriggling worm.
[firmly] That’s for every pearl you stole.
[warmly, slowly] And that’s for my shell!
[triumphant] The Heart Pearl rises home, and the whole reef shines again.
[softly] Dig into the sand, push the red pearl into the gate.
lines.when: Level 1: soon after the level starts (narrator)

lines.text: [gently] The gate is awake! Swim in.
[curious] Red eyes… I can’t stop thinking about them.
lines.when: Level 2: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Two gates! I can feel my glow coming back!
[excited] A giant eel who drinks light… Let’s be quick.
lines.when: Level 3: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Three! Shelly’s waiting for us!
[scared] Watch for that dark tail the crabs saw.
lines.when: Level 4: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Four gates. Take that, Grimtide!
[excited] A piranha! Be careful down there!
lines.when: Level 5: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Five! Hear the jellies hum?
[excited] The jellies say the Keeper’s chest is close!
lines.when: Level 6: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Six gates! The wreck should be just ahead.
[curious] The map says this gate has a keystone. Careful!
lines.when: Level 7: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Seven! Hey… do you see that glow over there?
[scared] My glow is so faint… stay close to me.
lines.when: Level 8: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] We did it without the map!
[curious] Ink everywhere… He came this way.
lines.when: Level 9: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Nine! A torn piece of the map is near, I can feel it!
[excited] The last gate of the Shallows. Then the cliff.
lines.when: Level 10: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Ten gates. Down we go, together!
[whispers, echoing] Little light… turn back.
lines.when: Level 11: soon after the level starts (Grimtide)

lines.text: [excited] Eleven! Ha! He can echo all he likes.
[scared] The silent clam… We’ll get its pearl back.
lines.when: Level 12: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Twelve. Why does the water feel so heavy?
[sadly, quietly] Something’s wrong… the water is going dark.
lines.when: Level 13: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Thirteen… Wait. Do you hear that?
[quietly] Shelly would want us to keep going.
lines.when: Level 14: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Fourteen. Rest well, Shelly.
[sadly, quietly] For Shelly. Let’s go!
lines.when: Level 15: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Fifteen gates! She’d be so proud.
[excited] That prisoner… those chains… Hurry.
lines.when: Level 16: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Sixteen! The old arch is just ahead.
[scared] Light that’s given away. Remember that.
lines.when: Level 17: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Seventeen! Look, pearls rising from the sand!
[determined] Follow the pearls. He’s helping us.
lines.when: Level 18: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Eighteen! Someone’s coming. My cousins?
[excited] Shelly says hi! Race you to the gate!
lines.when: Level 19: soon after the level starts (Pip’s cousin)

lines.text: [excited] Nineteen! Shelly’s okay, I’m so happy!
[excited] He’s wrapped around the Lantern… Hurry!
lines.when: Level 20: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Twenty. The Deep is next. Stay close.
[cheerful] Sleeping piranhas. Shh… tiptoe.
lines.when: Level 21: soon after the level starts (Lumen)

lines.text: [cheerful] Twenty-one! The Deep felt that one.
[cheerful] Old Bellow is singing for you. Keep going!
lines.when: Level 22: soon after the level starts (Lumen)

lines.text: [excited] Twenty-two! He’s getting weaker!
[cheerful] The pressure is strong down here. Watch your air.
lines.when: Level 23: soon after the level starts (Lumen)

lines.text: [excited] Twenty-three. Poor Murk… we’re coming.
[menacing, low] I see you, little light.
lines.when: Level 24: soon after the level starts (Grimtide)

lines.text: [excited] Twenty-four! Look how bright it… wait, what’s that shadow?
[warmly, slowly] We’ll find him. Wake this gate and follow the light.
lines.when: Level 25: soon after the level starts (Shelly)

lines.text: [warmly, slowly] Hold on, Pip. We’re coming!
[warmly, slowly] Murk’s den is close. I can feel it.
lines.when: Level 26: soon after the level starts (Shelly)

lines.text: [warmly, slowly] Twenty-six. Now, to Pip!
[curious] Thank you for coming for me. Now, let’s finish this!
lines.when: Level 27: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [softly] Twenty-seven. His lair is near.
[cheerful] Look behind you. The whole Deep is glowing!
lines.when: Level 28: soon after the level starts (Lumen)

lines.text: [excited] Twenty-eight! Everyone is with us!
[menacing, low] Turn back, or lose everything.
lines.when: Level 29: soon after the level starts (Grimtide)

lines.text: [softly] One gate left. Let’s end this.
[scared] This is it. The last gate!
lines.when: Level 30: soon after the level starts (Pip)

lines.text: [excited] Now! Swim in and light it up!
